SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo ni somo la kusoma: Kusoma 14.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Kifungu cha mjadala. Soma maelezo, fuata mifano iliyofanyiwa kazi, kisha fanya mazoezi.

1. Explain the main ideas in Kusoma 14.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Kifungu cha mjadala
2. Give Kenyan examples for Kusoma 14.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Kifungu cha mjadala

SEHEMU 3: SOMO (MAELEZO NA MIFANO)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: KUSOMA 14.2.1 KUSOMA KWA UFAHAMU KIFUNGU CHA MJADALA
This lesson teaches Kusoma 14.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Kifungu cha mjadala for Grade 8 KISWAHILI.

STUDY STEPS
1. Explain the main ideas in Kusoma 14.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Kifungu cha mjadala
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. Give Kenyan examples for Kusoma 14.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Kifungu cha mjadala
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. Practise Kusoma 14.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Kifungu cha mjadala at school and at home
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO YA HARAKA

Example 1: Describe Kusoma 14.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Kifungu cha mjadala using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: MAZOEZI

1. Underline the key ideas about Kusoma 14.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Kifungu cha mjadala above.
2. Explain Kusoma 14.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Kifungu cha mjadala to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Kusoma 14.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Kifungu cha mjadala.

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA NYUMBANI

1. Write five sentences about Kusoma 14.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Kifungu cha mjadala with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Kusoma 14.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Kifungu cha mjadala important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

2. Give Kenyan examples for Kusoma 14.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Kifungu cha mjadala
